description: Create a partner API key (admin or partner-manager).

partnerName.description: The partner the key is issued to.

allowedOrigins.description: Origins the key may be used from. Each must publish the verification token before the key is usable.

permissions.description: What the key may do. Default ['register'].

rateLimitPerHour.description: Registrations allowed per hour with this key.

ticketPublicKey.description: did:key (secp256k1 or P-256) the partner's backend signs registration tickets with. With it, registrations require a ticket and produce approved, signed-in accounts. Without it, registrations produce pending accounts that are approved once their email is verified.
